policy.owner: Platform security and Next UI maintainers
policy.exit_criteria: Every registered JSX style prop is replaced by a reviewed class, native attribute, bounded DOM adapter, or another representation compatible with style-src-attr 'none'; every runtime style element is removed or receives the exact per-response nonce through a reviewed host boundary. The single registered landing style element remains bounded to one and is re-ratcheted to zero once a reviewed same-origin stylesheet route replaces it.

exceptions.owner: Platform security and Next storefront maintainers
exceptions.reason: Published landing CSS is per-page and cannot be emitted as a static stylesheet. The Next storefront scopes it and emits one style element that carries the exact request-local CSP nonce issued by the proxy.
exceptions.constraints: Exactly one runtime style element, with the exact nonce supplied by getRequestCspNonce(); no JSX style attributes, direct DOM style writes, unregistered style elements, or user-authored nonce values.
exceptions.exit_criteria: Replace the inline style element with a reviewed same-origin stylesheet route that serves the scoped CSS, or prove with cross-stack browser evidence that the nonce-bearing element is the only viable boundary, then re-ratchet the runtime-style-element count to zero.
